newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta shares mixed, government stock boosts volume.
newsitem.headline: Malta shares mixed, government stock boosts volume.

text.p: Maltese stocks were mixed on Wednesday as turnover rose to more than three million Malta pounds ($7.38m) at the weekly trading session of the Malta Stock Exchange from 364,000 Malta pounds the previous week.

The share index rose by 2.36 to 1089.92 points. Most of the trading was in Malta government stock, while turnover in the equities market fell to 105,406 pounds, with a mere 58,982 shares shares changing hands in 73 deals.

The biggest loser was soft drinks maker Simonds Farsons Cisk, with the average price of its six percent preference shares falling by 14 cents to 985 cents after 2,466 shares changed hands in 16 deals.
Bank of Valletta shares gained 1c3, with 38,694 shares selling in 37 deals for an average 148 cents.
Mid-Med Bank shares gained three mils, with 8,600 selling for an average 179.2 cents per share.
Lombard Bank Malta lost one mil, with 2,400 shares selling in three deals for an average 160 cents.
Middle Sea Insurance Suncrest and Farsons ordinary and 8.5 percent
preference shares showed no change, selling at an average of 124c, 73c, 46c2 and 98.7c respectively.
In Malta government stocks, turnover reached 2.9 million pounds with 16 securities dealt in 59 deals. ($1: 0.40c5 Malta pounds)
